# Anbennar Overhaul: a Lich's raised dead and the men-at-arms a Lich gives up.

# Character scope: may recruit or enlarge raised dead
aov_lich_maa_can_recruit = {
	has_trait = lich
	custom_description = {
		text = aov_lich_maa_needs_mana
		value = aov_lich_maa_next_cost
		aov_mana >= aov_lich_maa_next_cost
	}
}

# Regiment scope: raised dead
aov_lich_maa_regiment = {
	OR = {
		is_maa_type = aov_lich_skeletons
		is_maa_type = aov_lich_skeleton_archers
	}
}

# aov_lich_maa_forbidden_regiment (the living soldiers a Lich gives up) is generated by tools/build_lich_maa.py
